caption:
Reusing one password is risky: if one site leaks it, attackers try it everywhere. 🔐

1️⃣ Use a password manager (many have free plans)
2️⃣ Let it create long random passwords
3️⃣ Remember just one strong master password

scenes.text: Using one password everywhere? That is a big risk.

scenes.myth: I can't remember a different password for every site.
scenes.fact: You don't have to. A password manager remembers them for you.
scenes.say: Myth. I can't remember a different password for every site. Fact. You don't have to. A password manager does it for you.

scenes.title: Set it up in 3 steps
scenes.say: Pick a trusted password manager, many have free plans. Let it generate random passwords. Then remember just one strong master password.

scenes.title: Change email and bank first
scenes.body: Your email can reset every other account.
scenes.say: Start with your email and banking logins. Your email can reset every other account.
